pli-tv-pvr1.7:1.1: methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevantassa āpattiyo sattannaṃ samathānaṃ katīhi samathehi sammanti.
pli-tv-pvr1.7:1.3: siyā sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca siyā sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca. --la--.
pli-tv-pvr1.7:2.1: anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake . . . karontassa āpatti sattannaṃ samathānaṃ katīhi . . .
pli-tv-pvr1.7:2.3: siyā sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca siyā sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca. samathavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ sattamaṃ. ||7||
